title: Upgrade Your Phone’s Aesthetics During Burga’s Sale on Cases and Accessories
gist: Burga is running a promotion on Shop with $25 off orders of $50 or more on its phone cases and accessories. The sale is mostly iPhone cases at about $50 each, plus a few Samsung options.

insights.claim: Burga's sale on Shop offers $25 off orders of $50 or more, applied automatically at checkout, with cases priced at around $50 each.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Shows promotional pricing and the use of a third-party commerce channel for a DTC accessories brand.
